channel.title: Paksh: Politics
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV Votes by Mail in US Election
item.description: Pope Leo XIV has become the first pontiff to vote in a U.S. election, casting his ballot by mail. This marks a historic moment for the papacy and its engagement with the U.S. electoral process. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
